overview: Regulatory Capital Data Lineage and Reconciliation addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in banking and payments operations. The first proof of value uses finance GL, risk RWA and regulatory templates. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is unreconciled reporting balances, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: finance GL, risk RWA and regulatory templates; define unreconciled reporting balances and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Payments / Chief Risk Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
